titles.native: ストローザウルス ネオ

description:
"Straw-saurus Neo is a small dinosaur from space. He came looking for his friend who has gone missing and sets out to find him in the sandy wilds of the planet."

Short animation starring dinosaurs made from straws broadcasted on NHK Educational TV.
